brief.topic: Wishing for others what you wish for yourself
brief.audience: Muslims looking for a short, authentic reminder they can act on today

coreInsight: Sahih al-Bukhari 13 links faith to wishing for your brother what you like for yourself.

caption.opening: When a friend gets the thing you wanted, what's your first feeling?
body: Sahih al-Bukhari 13 ties faith to wishing for your brother what you like for yourself.

Try this today:
→ congratulate someone sincerely
→ make du'a for a friend by name
→ pass on a good opportunity you found

claims.text: What bukhari:13 says, quoted verbatim on screen.
Congratulating, making du'a and sharing opportunities are ways to act on the hadith.
